name: mod-pack
description: A pack of small Claude Code mods that share the band above the prompt without overwriting each other. Turn each one on or off with /mods.

tokenWeather.title: Token Weather
tokenWeather.description: Show the context-window forecast above the prompt.

cacheKeeper.title: Cache Keeper
cacheKeeper.description: Show a countdown of how long the prompt cache stays warm after the last response, with a compact button, a warning toast in the last 5 minutes, and a cold notice. Costs no model tokens.

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long Claude Code's prompt cache lives, for Cache Keeper's countdown. Anthropic documents 60 for the main conversation on a Claude subscription within plan usage, and 5 on an API key, a cloud provider, or usage credits. Mod-pack cannot read which one you have: set 5 there. A value that is not between 0 and 1440 counts as 60.

promptQueue.title: Prompt Queue
promptQueue.description: Type /q <text> while Claude works to queue follow-up prompts. They are sent one at a time when a turn ends, and a row above the prompt shows what waits. Costs no model tokens of its own: each queued prompt becomes a normal turn on your plan, and runs with your permissions when it is sent automatically.

waitWhat.title: Wait What
waitWhat.description: After a long answer (200 characters or more), show a retell in plain words, at most 2 short lines, above the prompt. SPENDS MODEL TOKENS: each retold answer sends up to 4000 characters of the answer's text to the cheapest model (the haiku alias) on your own plan and reads about one short reply back. Off by default. The retell is not in the transcript and not in the model's context.

maxModelCallsPerHour.title: Wait What: model calls per hour
maxModelCallsPerHour.description: The most model calls Wait What makes in a rolling hour, counted per session. Each retold answer is one call. Default 30. 0 means no call. A value that is not a number from 0 to 1000 counts as 30.

blastRadius.title: Blast Radius
blastRadius.description: Ask Proceed or Cancel, with a preview of what would change, before Claude runs a risky shell command (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git push --force, ...). A non-interactive run denies those commands. Costs no model tokens.

shipGate.title: Ship Gate
shipGate.description: Ask Proceed or Cancel, with a check for personal strings (your user name in the folder path, a non-noreply git e-mail, your own list), before git push, gh repo create, GitHub Pages changes and gh repo edit --visibility public. Deny git commit of code files when no test, type check or validator has passed on the current tree. Costs no model tokens.

shipGateTerms.title: Ship Gate: personal strings
shipGateTerms.description: Extra strings that Ship Gate searches for in the text files of the tree before a push, separated by commas. Your user name in the folder path and a git e-mail that is not a noreply address are searched without this setting.

snake.title: Snake
snake.description: Type /snake to play Snake in a pane. It pauses when Claude finishes and goes on when you send the next prompt. The keys w a s d p r work while the pane has the keyboard. Terminal only. Costs no model tokens.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Let features that can play a sound do so. Off by default. Claude Code plays plugin sound only where it has a player (macOS).
